summary: The ep-30 regression is a FALSE positive: ep 30 (2015-06-12) is correct and the typo is on ep 29. Rows 21-32 are Nisekoi: (season 2) eps 1-12, which aired weekly Fridays 2015-04-10 to 2015-06-26 with no skips; ja-WP's episode table labels them '第9話（第29話）' etc., confirming our cumulative numbering. No shift between stored and published dates.

repairs.why: Ep 29 = Nisekoi: (S2) ep 9 'Cleanup Day / Visiting the Sick' (オソウジ／オミマウ), aired 2015-06-05 (Fri 23:30). Stored 2015-07-05 is a month-digit slip and is what produced the ep-30 regression; ep 30 (2015-06-12) is correct. The S2 run is strictly weekly 04-10..06-26, which fixes ep 9 uniquely.

structure.notes: Rows 21-32 = Nisekoi: S2 eps 1-12 (+20 offset); ja-WP prints the cumulative number in the same table, so the join is exact. Season-2 OVA (2016-01-04) is not among our rows.
